justification: Adds an opt-in reader (DCP_READER=section). Off by default, so no chapter is read differently until it is switched on for the pilot; output goes to the review queue like every reader.

pre_impl.existing_data: none read or written by the reader; it returns ai_extractor.provisions_to_sections dicts to the existing review-queue path
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: PDF reading order fails on two-column pages; each page takes whichever of the two existing readings runs sentences on
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: applies only when DCP_READER=section is set
pre_impl.external_source_error: an unusable model answer is retried once, then counted as an empty answer and printed
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: rule lines no rule covers are printed per chapter, so a skipped rule is visible before review

functions.name: section_reader.build
functions.input: the chapter's printed lines and the model's line ranges
functions.output: rules whose text is the PDF lines first..last, with heading path, label and lead-in
functions.if_none: no rules; every rule-worded line is then listed as uncovered

values.guard_at: _int and range checks against the piece
values.if_missing: that rule is skipped and its lines show as uncovered

break_it.scenario: The model returns a line range that overlaps the previous rule
break_it.what_happens: the same council words would be served twice under two rules
break_it.how: the earlier rule keeps its lines; the later one starts after it or is dropped

break_it.scenario: A condition line such as 'where the site adjoins' is returned as its own rule
break_it.what_happens: the condition would be shown apart from the rule it qualifies
break_it.how: a rule starting lower-case or with where/unless joins the rule before it unless that ended a sentence

break_it.scenario: Items (a)(b) after a lead-in ending with a colon
break_it.what_happens: each item would be served without the sentence that says when it applies
break_it.how: the lead-in line is copied onto each item; a lead-in returned alone is dropped

break_it.scenario: Two-column page read straight across both columns
break_it.what_happens: rules would be stitched from two columns into nonsense
break_it.how: per page, the reading order whose lines run on as sentences is used; jumbled pages are also read from the image

falsifiable_check.fails_when: rule text differs from the joined PDF lines, or overlaps/lead-ins/conditions are mishandled
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Hornsby 3-14 scored 2/12 before the reading-order choice; the 100-page key score is the outside check
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Opus 100-page answer key (17 councils, 977 entries) scored against live site and this reader

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: DCP_READER=section dcp_extract_changed --review on Parramatta (pilot), compared with the before snapshot
